text:
Transformers | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a weekly bases as indicated by 
W1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Salah Kamel Moustafa (HV-Dep. Manager), tested by eng. 
Hany Hamed Abd EL Hamed, accepted by eng. 
Sayed Farag; general director, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady head sector of Ataka PS.
This document accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained and 
 qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 safety 
 belt when cleaning suspension insulators, etc.
Transformer must be out 
 of service, isolated and grounded from both sides.
Taking out the ...kv breaker of bus bar 
 ...kv.
Disconnect supply of DC.
Environmental Recommendation
Before starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of the transformers, 
 wear your breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 tool kit including a torque wrench tool.
Safety helmet, safety belt
Voltage indicator HV tester rod.
Thermometer, 
 Oil Level Indicator
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes, 
 new silica-gel.
Work to be Carried Out
Read and 
 record oil and winding temperature w.r.t. the load.
Check and 
 record oil level gauges.
Check by 
 ears for abnormal transformer noise.
Check by 
 ears and eyes for fans vibration or abnormal sound.
Check 
 visually for oil leak.
Check the 
 color of the silica-gel.
Check the 
 level of the sealing oil in the oil cup of the breather.
Check for 
 dust accumulation on radiator surface.
Check for 
 cleanless of the HV bushing.
Check and 
 confirm the operation of the cooling fans and pumps w.r.t. winding 
 temperature.
